messages:
Ethan (Product): Usability lab recap: users get overwhelmed by the long vertical list of probes in Private/VPC setup. They wanted a clearer path to 'next steps' when things fail.
Maya (Design): Thinking: add a slim diagnostic ribbon at top of the Network step that summarizes status (All good / Action needed) with a single CTA 'Show diagnostics' that scrolls to the expanded area. Less visual noise and clearer call-to-action.
Kofi (Eng): Backend can emit a concise `diagnostic_summary` with fields like status, fail_count, and primary_kb_id. That should let the ribbon be authoritative without extra polling.
Lina (Frontend): From implementation POV: ribbon is always visible, keyboard-focusable, with role=button and aria-expanded. Hitting Enter toggles the detailed accordion. When collapsed, only summary is announced via aria-live="polite".
A11yBot: Accessibility note: ensure ribbon has meaningful text for screen readers like 'Network checks: 2 issues. Press Enter for details.' Don't rely on color alone for status.
Maya (Design): Copy option for ribbon: 'Network checks 0bbb 2 issues bb Show diagnostics'. Also include a tiny inline hint: 'Helpful KB links inside'.
Ethan (Product): Also proposal: group probes by type (Connectivity / Firewall / DNS). Users said grouping helped them map issues to infra owners.
Kofi (Eng): Grouping makes sense. We'll include `group_id` in probe events so UI can render collapsible sublists. Backend will also surface a `primary_kb_id` per group.
Lina (Frontend): UI detail: preserve keyboard tab order, use skip link 'Jump to diagnostics' for quick navigation, and make expand/collapse state persist across retries.
Maya (Design): Visual polish: ribbon uses subtle shadow and 48px height, keeps timestamps off to reduce clutter. In details view we keep per-probe timestamps and a small 'Open KB' button.
Ethan (Product): Action items: Kofi to add `diagnostic_summary` + `group_id` & `primary_kb_id`; Maya to finalize ribbon copy and visual spec; Lina to prototype keyboard interactions and focus management; A11yBot to sign off on live region usage. Target: next sprint demo.
DeployBot: Deployment pipeline will run when feature branch `diagnostic-ribbon` is pushed.
Lina (Frontend): I'll drop a small prototype link here by Friday and include notes for screen-reader walkthrough.
Ethan (Product): Thanks team. If ribbon reduces the perceived clutter, support tickets should go down and engineers know who to call faster.
